messages.subject: Re: Can deploy, but disconnect every time after launch. Log with no error. Please help!
parts:
When I use your link, I get an infinite redirect, for which I will log a bug.
If I use the lowercase form of the application name, https://dsconsulting.shinyapps.io/loan_app3/, I do not experience a disconnect after launch.
